Learn and reuse a common channel aggregation

Source: R/channelGroups.R
channelGroups.Rd

Cluster outcome channels using size-adjusted Poisson distances and Ward linkage. The resulting map can be reused across samples or learned from reference spectra supplied as rows with normalize=TRUE.

Usage

channelGroups(
  y,
  k = 32L,
  channels = colnames(y),
  normalize = FALSE,
  ncores = NULL
)

aggregateChannels(y, groups, channels = colnames(y))

Arguments

y

Numeric matrix with channels in columns.

k

Maximum number of channel groups.

channels

Unique channel identifiers, normally m/z values.

normalize

Give every input row unit total, useful for spectral libraries.

ncores

Native thread count, defaulting to physical cores.

groups

A map returned by channelGroups().

Value

channelGroups() returns a compact reusable map accepted as precluster by logconNMF(). aggregateChannels() returns a matrix whose columns sum the mapped channels. Unseen channels are collected in the map's reserved group. Save maps with saveRDS().

Examples

y <- matrix(rpois(100*12, 3), 100, 12)
groups <- channelGroups(y, k=4L, ncores=1L)
z <- aggregateChannels(y, groups)
stopifnot(sum(y) == sum(z))
